method: Hand-assembled aggregation of committed records, per manifests/design-evidence-tiers.md item 8 (no klt aggregation verb exists; upstream tracker klayout-tools#309). Records aggregated: verification/readout/functional-verification.report.json and functional-verification-sdf.report.json (spec row 5 function, pre- and post-layout), sta/readout.osc-corner.sta.report.json (spec row 5 corner-matched counter timing) and sta/readout.sta.report.json with sta/README.md (reference-clock domain and its disclosures), spec/target-spec.md section 6 with verification/readout/not-statistical.json (spec row 6, not recorded), layout/readout/report.json with layout/README.md (Fmax, area, power, 16-corner P&R sweep; spec row 8 digital share), drc/README.md and lvs/README.md (spec row 9 digital share). SIMULATED throughout: Icarus 13.0 / cocotb 2.1.0 RTL and SDF-annotated gate-level runs, klt sta 0.9.1 static timing on the routed DEF with no SPEF and ideal clocks, and OpenROAD place-and-route flow output. Partition split for rows 5 and 6 per spec/digital-rows.json.
summary: T1 item 8 (Characterization report), digital partition. SIMULATED aggregation of already-committed records; no simulation, synthesis, place-and-route or extraction was run for it, and no spec bound or recorded verdict is changed. Indexed by spec/target-spec.md section, not by T1 item. Spec row 5 (readout) splits: the counter's function PASSES every committed check (9/9 cocotb on RTL, 8/8 SDF-annotated at typ), but the corner-matched static timing is a recorded FAIL -- the counter does not cover osc_hd in any of the three liberty corners (setup slack -2.921 / -1.227 / -0.724 ns at ss_100C_1v60 / tt_025C_1v80 / ff_n40C_1v95) -- and the reference-clock accuracy requirement is a requirement on an input the block does not generate, so it is NOT RECORDED. Spec row 6 (conversion time) is NOT RECORDED: no committed record grades a conversion time against its bounds, and spec/target-spec.md's 5 x 102.4 us ~ 0.5 ms is a planning figure the spec itself labels unverified. A recorded FAIL plus an ungraded row means a 'pass' would overclaim, so this envelope is 'fail'. Rows recorded as NOT RECORDED, listed rather than omitted: row 6 above, row 8 (area, no whole-block verdict in any committed record -- only the readout die share, 39 970 um2, which layout/README.md explicitly does not judge), and row 9 (no whole-block signoff verdict; the partition's 3.digital / 4.digital / 7.digital components are listed as components, not as a row 9 pass). The T1 item-8 digital requirement is covered: counter Fmax 171.1 / 358.9 / 586.8 MHz over the three liberty corners, die area 39 970 um2 at 42.943 % utilization, and flow-estimated power 268.8 uW -- a single nominal-corner figure with engine_default activity and estimate_only parasitics, so power across the corner set is NOT RECORDED. spec/decisions/0003-counter-max-input-frequency.md is cited as a draft proposal only and resolves nothing. Nothing here is measured.
